meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先探测文件大小与可用内存,再选 DuckDB、Polars、numpy 等引擎直接分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON,做分组、连接、聚合、时序、分布、清洗和绘图,并报告行数与耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等格式的数据集,或需要分组、聚合、清洗、绘图等数据操作时触发。

say.text: 把这个 CSV 按城市分组,统计每城订单量
say.note: 先加载进 DuckDB,后续查询走内存

say.text: 这个 Parquet 有 5 亿行,内存放不下,帮我算均值
say.note: 改用流式或直接读文件,不整份载入

say.text: 画一张销售额随时间变化的折线图
say.note: 按可视化规范出图并做视觉检查

howto.what_en: Claude probes file size and free RAM, then picks an engine (DuckDB, Polars, numpy) to query CSV, Parquet or JSON: grouping, joins, aggregation, time series, cleaning, charts. It reports row counts and timing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze a CSV, Parquet or JSON dataset, or to do grouping, aggregation, cleaning or plotting on data.

say_en.text: Group this CSV by city and count orders per city
say_en.note: Loads once into DuckDB, later queries hit memory

say_en.text: This Parquet has 500M rows, over RAM — compute the mean
say_en.note: Streams or reads the file in place instead

say_en.text: Plot sales over time as a line chart
say_en.note: Follows the visualization guide and visual QA
